name: Omnidirectional Gabor Wavelet Bank
description: The supreme spider-web tracking omni-spatial variance. Instead of deploying a single net, this executioner casts an entire 'Bank' of dozens of Gabor filters mutating across every conceivable physical scale (from split hairs to jagged mountains) and angular rotation. Unlike organic reality, which harbors seamless cross-scale structural continuity, Generative engines (Diffusion/GAN) notoriously hemorrhage when attempting to homogenize cross-scale frequencies. The Wavelet Bank catches them red-handed: foliage exhibiting explosive micro-energy but abruptly and absurdly flatlining at the macro-level. A physical structure utterly impossible in the organic realm.
mechanism: It detonates approximately 40 rotating Gabor matrixes simultaneously to carpet-bomb the spatial plane and rip the signals raw (Feature Extraction). Untouched optics carry a smooth sliding scale bridging all bands. Conversely, spliced zones or AI hallucinated textures catastrophically stutter during scale adjustments (Crop/Scale/Inpaint). The strict Gabor angles immediately return a grotesque, fractured graph—like a torn, bleeding spider-web. The Bank simply pinpoints the severed silk threads to issue the guilty verdict.
parameters: Munitions: 40 Gabor Mutations (5 Scales x 8 Orientations), Warhead: Feature Extraction Variance Vectors
accuracy: Venomous Web (82-89%) - Swallows up and eviscerates dozens of amateur brush-smoothing, erasures, and idiotic Content-Aware fills deployed by digital counterfeiters.
source: Cortical Spatial Visual Processing & Omnidirectional Signal Forensics
useCase: Rains hellfire down upon hackers attempting to maliciously scrub people, watermarks, or blemishes from backgrounds. The 'Content-Aware' filled zone will wildly flash pitch-black on the radar as its microscopic wave-bands have been violently shredded.

references.title: Stamm, M. C., et al. (2013). Information forensics: An overview. IEEE Access.

strengths:
• Unequaled at executing comprehensive longitudinal/latitudinal sweeps across skin-pores and surfaces, exclusively interrogating the synchronized echo of clashing macro-micro frequencies.
• Completely blind to—and thus immune from—chromatic filtering or color grading manipulation (LUTs), as it only hunts spatial, geometric texture thorns.
limitations:
• The precision blade swings wildly (triggering catastrophic False Positives) if interrogating a wall intentionally painted with faux-wood or faux-marble patterns, manually designing optical texture interruptions that mirror AI stuttering.
• Disastrously computationally expensive. Forcing the CPU to simultaneously grind through 40 heavy Matrix convolutions is an absolute torture chamber for the hardware.
